lesson.grammar_point: imperatives with prepositions of movement for giving directions (walk along, go across, go through, go past, turn left at)

vocab.title: Match each word to its meaning
defs: a sign at the side of a road that shows the way to a place
to not know where you are or how to find your way
a round place where roads meet and cars drive around in a circle
a shorter and faster way to go somewhere
to go in the direction of a place
a place where two roads meet and cross each other
the place in a station where you wait for the train or the bus
the part of a street from one cross street to the next

items.situation: Tell me how to get from this room to the nearest cafe.
A tourist asks you for a shortcut to the station. Answer him.
You are lost in Ljubljana. Stop someone and ask for help.
Explain to a driver what to do at a big roundabout.
Tell me how to find your favorite building in Sao Paulo.
Someone asks you: Is it far? Give an honest answer.
tips: It depends on where you're coming from

listenings.text: Hi Ricardo, this is Maja, from the apartment in Ljubljana. Here is the way from the bus station. Don't take a taxi. It's only fifteen minutes on foot. When you leave the station, turn left and walk along the main road for two blocks. At the crossroads, turn right and go across the bridge. It's the Dragon Bridge, with four green dragons, so you can't miss it. Then walk along the river, past the market. Our building is the yellow one on the corner, right after the second bridge. Call me when you are at the door, and I will come down. See you soon!

Last summer I rented a car in Slovenia and drove from Ljubljana to Lake Bled. It is not a long trip, but I got lost at the first big roundabout. I took the wrong exit, came back, and took the wrong exit again. Three times! In the end I stopped next to a field and asked an old farmer for help. He was very calm. He said: Go back to the roundabout, go around it, and take the second exit. Then go straight on for five kilometers, past a small white church. At the signpost for Bled, turn left. I followed every word, and twenty minutes later I was at the lake. Sometimes the best map is a person.

extra_audio.text: First Ricardo got off the ferry and asked a woman for the way to the palace. Then he walked along the harbor, toward the old town. After that he went past a big hotel and a long line of palm trees. At that point he saw a small gate in the wall, on his right. In the end he went through the gate, up the stairs, and into the Peristyle.
